definition: Which field APB writes.
The plain amino-acid sequence: ProForma_peptide (PSI-MS MS:1000888, stripped peptide sequence).
The sequence with its modifications in ProForma notation: ProForma_peptidoform (PSI-MS MS:1003169, proforma peptidoform sequence).

The sequence with modifications whose positions the vendor does not report, as ProForma unknown-position groups: ProForma_peptidoform_unlocalized, which MaxQuant's peptidoform level writes instead of ProForma_peptidoform.
The peptidoform with its charge: ProForma_ion (PSI-MS MS:1003270, proforma peptidoform ion notation).
A fragment of a peptidoform ion: ProForma_ion with the fragment label, ProForma_fragment.
Whether the vendor marks the feature as a decoy: apb_Decoy.
Whether the vendor marks the feature as a contaminant it flags or adds itself: apb_Contaminant.
The protein or protein group the vendor assigns the feature to: the var column the level's rule marks with the role protein_assignment.
The FASTA accessions the vendor lists for the feature: the var column the level's rule marks with the role fasta_accessions.
The experimental group a sample belongs to, as MSstats' Condition.
The biological replicate a sample comes from; one value across conditions marks a repeated subject, as MSstats' BioReplicate.

Chromatographic retention times of a feature and the bounds and widths of its elution peak, with their original unit. Measured, aligned, predicted and library values are different kinds, as run, library and global q-values are in confidence. The catalogue identifies fields; consumers perform any unit conversion.
purpose: Retention times, elution-peak bounds and peak widths, with the unit the software reports them in.
used_by: apb-export: QPX feature retention times in seconds for pMultiQC

definition: Which chromatographic quantity the value is.
Where the feature eluted in this run, measured on the run's own time axis: the apex or centre of its elution peak.
The measured retention time, moved by the software's alignment onto a scale shared by all runs: a reference run's time axis or the library's iRT scale.
Where the software expects the feature to elute in this run, from its library or prediction model calibrated to the run; not a measurement.
The spectral library's reference retention time, the same in every run.
A mean of apex times the software reports beside its apex retention time; what it averages over is not established.
The time of the MS/MS spectrum that identified the feature, rather than the apex of its elution peak.
Where the feature's elution peak begins, on the run's own time axis.
Where the feature's elution peak ends, on the run's own time axis.

Where the elution peak ends, on the aligned scale of aligned_retention_time.
The width of the elution peak at half its maximum height.
